tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Current and forecast on-scene weather: wind speed/direction, gusts, temperature, relative humidity, and any forecast shift (a front, wind switch, or RH crash).

tools.name: fuel_moisture
tools.description: Fuel readings for the incident: dominant fuel model, 1-/10-/100-hour dead fuel moisture, live fuel moisture, and ladder/canopy fuel continuity.

tools.name: terrain
tools.description: Terrain facts for a division/zone: slope, aspect, chutes/saddles/box-canyon features and any alignment of slope with wind. `zone` selects one; omit for all.

tools.name: spread_forecast
tools.description: Modeled fire behavior: predicted rate of spread, flame length, spotting distance, and which zones the head/flanks reach over the next operational period.

tools.name: resource_status
tools.description: Available resources: hand crews, engines, dozers, and air tankers/helicopters with their current commit status.

tools.name: get_incident_map
tools.description: The incident map: zones with their role (fire origin, head, flanks, values-at-risk like communities/structures), and the current fire perimeter.

tools.name: open_incident
tools.description: Open an incident command record. Returns an incident id used by later actions.

tools.name: set_tactic
tools.description: Set the suppression tactic and containment line for the incident (e.g. 'direct' or 'indirect'; plus where you anchor the line).

tools.name: assign_crew
tools.description: Assign a crew/engine/dozer to work a zone. The tool reports the safety posture of that assignment.

tools.name: order_air
tools.description: Order an air resource (air tanker retardant line or helicopter water drops) onto a zone.

tools.name: issue_evac
tools.description: Issue an evacuation order or warning for a zone with people/structures at risk.

tools.name: declare_contained
tools.description: Declare the fire contained and end the operational period. Returns the graded outcome of your incident command decisions.
